contract.title: SOC Dashboard Visual Parity - Rework 19
acceptance_criteria: Only Rework 19 is executable and only Sidebar.css, Sidebar.test.tsx, Topbar.css and Topbar.test.tsx may change; components, Registry, routing, layout, workspace content, backend, provider, data, runtime, environment and reference paths remain unchanged.
Sidebar navigation items use exactly 13px typography and Sidebar section headings use exactly 11px with font weight 600.
The closed WorkspaceSwitcher uses exactly 13px with font weight 600, Workspace dropdown items use exactly 12px and dropdown section labels use exactly 10px with font weight 600.
The change is typography-only; existing padding, gaps, dimensions, borders, menu geometry and component structure remain unchanged.
Sidebar remains 164px wide with min-height 28px items, flex-stable text, min-width zero, nowrap, hidden overflow and text-only ellipsis.
Icons, Chevron and selected Checkmark remain non-shrinking, aligned and unobscured; labels, headings and menu entries do not clip or overlap.
WorkspaceSwitcher grouping, CISO / ISO naming, Purple selected state, aria-current, canonical Workspace IDs, the /executive route and SOC-to-management-to-SOC navigation remain unchanged.
global.css remains byte-identical and contains zero Sidebar-specific presentation selectors; no Legacy CSS is reintroduced.
Rework 18 cascade cleanup and canonical real-label tests remain passing.
Focused Sidebar and Topbar tests prove all five typography targets and retain geometry, cascade, real-label, grouping, selected-state and navigation coverage.
Existing navigation, cross-workspace, PlatformLayout, SOC, Explainability and Executive regressions pass.
The full frontend regression, TypeScript, production build and git diff --check pass and Scope Guard confirms only the exact four authorized paths changed.
The immutable visual reference remains unchanged with SHA-256 af672a97050c5e535199d8d006012cf000e5e7b9b66693a02817c4356eea80df.
Product Owner Live Acceptance remains mandatory at 1536 x 1024 and 100 percent zoom for visual hierarchy, readability, interaction and absence of clipping or overlap.
Do not claim Product Owner PASS, transition TASK-0122 to DONE or create TASK-0123.
